## Proof

Let $N = n!$. We seek
$$L = \lim_{n\to\infty}\sin^2\!\bigl(\pi\sqrt{N^2-N}\bigr),\qquad N=n!\to\infty.$$

**Step 1. Expand the square root.** For large $N$,
$$\sqrt{N^2-N}=N\sqrt{1-\tfrac1N}=N\Bigl(1-\tfrac{1}{2N}-\tfrac{1}{8N^2}-O(N^{-3})\Bigr)=N-\tfrac12-\tfrac{1}{8N}-O(N^{-2}).$$
Hence
$$\pi\sqrt{N^2-N}=\pi N-\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{\pi}{8N}-O(N^{-2}).$$

**Step 2. Use that $N=n!$ is an integer.** Write
$$\pi\sqrt{N^2-N}=\pi N-\alpha,\qquad \alpha:=\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{\pi}{8N}+O(N^{-2}).$$
Since $N\in\mathbb Z$,
$$\sin(\pi N-\alpha)=\sin(\pi N)\cos\alpha-\cos(\pi N)\sin\alpha=-(-1)^N\sin\alpha.$$
Therefore
$$\sin^2\!\bigl(\pi\sqrt{N^2-N}\bigr)=\sin^2\alpha.$$

**Step 3. Take the limit.** As $N=n!\to\infty$,
$$\alpha=\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{\pi}{8N}+O(N^{-2})\;\longrightarrow\;\frac{\pi}{2},$$
so
$$\sin^2\alpha\;\longrightarrow\;\sin^2\!\frac{\pi}{2}=1.$$

**Conclusion.**
$$\boxed{\lim_{n\to\infty}\sin^2\!\bigl(\pi\sqrt{(n!)^2-n!}\bigr)=1}.$$

### PROOF COMPLETE
